source_text: Munus similaginis cum oleo et ture — laus et oratio. Sacerdos memoriale incendit. Qui non potest pecudem, offert farinam: misericordia gradus pauperum novit.
pass_a_gloss: Gift of-fine-flour with oil and incense — praise and prayer. Priest memorial burns. Who not can livestock, offers meal: mercy degrees of-poor knows.
pass_b_english: The gift of [[fine flour with oil and frankincense >> Bible:Leviticus 2:1-2]] is praise and prayer. The priest burns the memorial portion. Who cannot bring a beast brings meal — mercy knows the poor’s measure.
